description: Get international trade statistics from the World Bank WITS (UN Comtrade data): export/import value, trade share and partner indicators for a reporter country, partner (default World), product/sector and one or more years. Values in US$ thousand for value indicators. Data: wits.worldbank.org, no auth required.

indicator.description: Trade indicator code (default "XPRT-TRD-VL" = export value, US$ thousand). Others: "MPRT-TRD-VL" (import value), "TRD-VL" (total trade), "XPRT-PRTNR-SHR".

partner.description: Partner country/region ISO3 code (default "wld" = World). E.g. "chn", "mex".

product.description: Product/sector code (default "Total"). Sector codes like "16-24_FoodProd", "27-27_Fuels", "Food", or HS codes.

year.description: Year or comma-separated years, max 10 (e.g. "2020" or "2018,2019,2020").

name: wits-trade.trade.get_stats

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: WITS Trade Flow Statistics
